title: Ask
body: Post in your website channel the way you'd brief a person. Links, photos and PDFs all work.

title: Draft
body: The right sheep makes the change on a private copy of your site. The live site isn't touched.

title: Check
body: Every change is tested, then you get a preview link with desktop and phone screenshots.

title: Publish
body: Happy with it? Press publish and it's live in under a minute. Undo stays on the message for seven days.
